purpose: Shared provider and lifecycle scenarios for native integration using fixture-app and host fixtures.

cases.input: Regular files containing 0, 1, 2, 3, 65535, 65536, 65537 and 200003 bytes; byte i = i modulo 251
cases.expect: data and managed copy bytes identical to input; size exact; base64 canonical and padded; no trailing zero bytes

cases.input: Metadata-only request with unavailable/offline contents, null cursor, absent columns, null or negative reported size
cases.expect: No complete-file read; Android absent metadata defaults to name File and null size; provider/coordination failures can still reject

cases.input: Reported size null, zero, too small or too large; actual length 65537; public limits 65536, 65537, null, zero and omitted
cases.expect: Managed copies and direct data enforce actual bytes; exact limit succeeds; explicit null is unlimited; zero or omitted required limits reject before picker dispatch; failure releases all partial batch resources

cases.input: Provider returns partial reads, Android zero-length bulk read, partial output writes, or an error after the first buffer
cases.expect: Bytes preserved; no available()-based size; all streams closed; no successful partial result

cases.input: Two selectable files with identical display names; duplicate URI; second file offline or too large
cases.expect: Distinct generated names for distinct files; ordered URI deduplication; failure rolls back all created outputs

cases.input: Display name ../source.bin; release source URI, path, directory ID, symlink ID, forged non-UUID or valid missing ID
cases.expect: Provider name never determines cache path; only plugin cache files can be removed; missing valid ID is idempotent; original source unchanged

cases.input: Cancel button, Android back, iOS swipe dismissal, browser cancel event; duplicate or late delegate events
cases.expect: One CancellationError with reason picker; AbortSignal uses reason signal; original request remains the sole owner of its callback

cases.input: Start a second picker while selection, direct reading or rollback is pending; independently start five managed reads
cases.expect: Second picker rejects BUSY; first still completes normally; managed reads queue with at most four native reads active

cases.input: Reset/dispose with picker displayed, copy queued, copy mid-stream, release queued or result awaiting main-thread delivery
cases.expect: No native callback to the replacement webview; abandoned copy output removed when I/O returns; stale picker cannot settle a newer request; browser pagehide revokes URLs

cases.input: Save Android state while picker is open; recreate plugin with replacement callback; deliver original result; repeat with invalid mode, request code and negative/unsafe limits
cases.expect: Mode, filter, multiplicity, all copy limits and request code restored; Cordova resume pendingResult delivers to replacement page; malformed state fails once and does not leave the plugin busy

cases.input: Security-scoped provider URL; access grant success/failure; coordinated read error; regular file versus directory/package
cases.expect: Balanced successful security-scope acquisition/release; one error on read failure; no recursive directory copy; metadata mode avoids Data(contentsOf:)

cases.input: iPad landscape/portrait restrictions, rapid reopen and existing modal on supported iOS 15+ versions
cases.expect: No incompatible orientation mask; safe popover anchor; no callback theft or stuck busy state; unavailable presenter returns an error

cases.input: Delete managed cache entry externally before release; navigate away/back in browser; terminate app mid-copy
cases.expect: Missing entry release succeeds; expired URI requires reselection; uncommitted interrupted copies recovered at the next process startup copy; unrecoverable leftovers remain cache-evictable and never source files

cases.input: Selections with duplicate native URIs, empty files, maxFiles at/below count, exact maxTotalSize, one excess byte, explicit null limits and a new request after failure
cases.expect: Count applies after normalization/deduplication and before content reads; actual bytes count across files; empty input still passes an exhausted budget; per-file and aggregate limits both apply; failed batch fully rolls back; budgets never leak to another request

cases.input: Reset while Android query/typed descriptor open or iOS coordination waits; repeat with a provider ignoring cancellation; release an earlier reference during the wait
cases.expect: Request-owned signal/coordinator receives cancellation; stale callbacks suppressed; release runs independently; partial output cleaned after blocked work returns; asset descriptor offsets and lengths remain honored

cases.input: Stop the app during staging before a journal exists, after intent journaling, between promotions, and after commit but before callback delivery; restart and start a copy
cases.expect: Startup recovery removes staged and uncommitted output; committed references survive, including the documented commit-to-callback crash gap; another request in the same process never sweeps active staging

cases.input: Inject rename failure, reset after the first promotion, failed deletion, malformed/traversal journal records, source/destination symlinks including dangling journal.tmp, and destination collision
cases.expect: No successful partial batch; retryable pending journal retained on cleanup failure; independent deletes still attempted; foreign files never overwritten/deleted; unsafe entries retained with redacted diagnostics

cases.input: Restore a saved reference; read beyond EOF, stream across UTF-8 boundaries, use aliases, release while reads and streams are active, then retry a failed release
cases.expect: Native ID lookup is authoritative; one-shot reads already started finish before deletion; streams stop; aliases share release state; unrelated files remain usable; malformed text rejects unless replacement was requested

cases.input: Select images, videos and a mixed batch from Android Photo Picker/fallback and iOS PHPicker; exercise metadata, managed and direct modes, count and byte limits, cancellation and immediate reopening
cases.expect: Media filters use system picker APIs; metadata does not load representations; selected current representations are read without plugin transcoding; provider imports and managed copies are cleaned up on failure or release

cases.input: Read each requested format from a source with inaccurate size and split UTF-8 sequences; abort during a blocked provider read; inject cleanup failure
cases.expect: Bounded bridge chunks; one content read for combined bytesAndDataURI; exact bytes and canonical padding; no retained managed copy; cancellation waits for actual I/O cleanup; CleanupError preserves original outcome and per-ID failures
